scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p docs/spec/tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && vp test run && npm run test:examples:run
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vp test run --project e2e-workspace --project e2e-package
scripts.test:package: npm run build && vp test run --project e2e-package
scripts.test:examples: npm run build && npm run test:examples:run
scripts.lint: vp lint --deny-warnings src e2e docs/examples scripts/docs.ts scripts/docs eslint.config.test.ts && eslint . --max-warnings 0
scripts.format: vp fmt src e2e scripts/docs.ts scripts/docs vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs eslint.config.test.ts
scripts.format:check: vp fmt --check src e2e scripts/docs.ts scripts/docs vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs eslint.config.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run check:docs
